title: SMS one-time-code sender: retrying calls to a flaky gateway with backoff
name: SMS retry policy

questions.prompt: The SMS provider's bill spiked and they rate-limited us: for numbers that were mistyped at sign-up (the provider answers 'invalid number' immediately), each login attempt now costs four submissions and several seconds of sleeping before the user sees an error. Timeouts and rate limits are being retried as intended. Fix call_with_retry so the tests pass.
